title: Text memo with the non-UTF-8 bytes ff fe survives a native round trip, or is refused
caps_note: MEMO_TEXT is an XDR string<28> (bytes, no character set) since the first protocol; not a CAP.
why: An XDR string is a byte string and stellar-core does not validate MEMO_TEXT, so ledgers hold text memos that are not UTF-8; an SDK that turns them into a native string and back replaces the bytes, and the rebuilt memo no longer matches the signed transaction.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/classic/api-memo-text-non-utf8-roundtrip.json. Origin: probe vector 7a, in evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json, executed in every probe column (evidence/sdk-matrix). Exact or refuse: the re-encoded Memo must be the input bytes (MEMO_TEXT, length 2, ff fe, padding), or the SDK refuses to give a native text. The driver's value (the native text's bytes) is not judged. Expected values were computed from the XDR definitions, the CAP or SEP text and the stellar-core rule cited under related, with an independent encoder; no SDK output was used.
